Usage:  circleci deploy list [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for list
      --jq string        Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json             Output as JSON
      --limit int        max number of deploys to return (0 = all) (default 10)
      --org-wide         list deploys across all projects in the org
      --project string   Project slug (e.g. gh/org/repo); defaults to git remote
